tags.feature: You can now choose on which rarity level or special catch type your frog stops fishing. You can find this option in the settings. Every time you catch a special variant of a fish for the first time, it's marked as new on the banner.

This feature was one of the most requested and we are happy to announce that it will be part of this update! We also changed the way you can move the frog around your screen: You can now drag and drop the frog so you do not need to open the settings to quickly move the frog out of the way.

The shop now contains a new, time limited tab with unique seasonal items! These seasonal items will be available in the shop over a certain timespan and they will return annually. For now, we created 6 new items (with different color variants) which will be available in the shop for a month from July 24th.

The daily quests now update properly without having to close the game on a new day. We know that a lot of people start playing our game in the evening so in order to give you all more time to complete your daily quests, they will not refresh at midnight but at 6 in the morning instead. (same goes for the shop refresh)

tags.bug: Fixed deleting saved data not always working properly
Fixed the money spent achievement stat being reset for some users. If this happened to you, your money spent will be restored!

notes.title: Summer update: New features & seasonal items!
notes.content: [h2]More AFK Fishing Options[/h2][p]In the settings, you can now choose at which rarity level or special catch type your frog will stop fishing and notify you. This lets you focus on rare or unique catches without missing a bite.[/p][p][/p][h2]Flip, Scale, and Move the Frog[/h2][p]Based on your top requests, we’ve added:[/p][list][*][p][b]Flip:[/b] Mirror your frog horizontally.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Scale:[/b] Adjust the frog’s size to your preference.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Drag & Drop:[/b] Simply click and drag the frog to a new position—no need to open the settings menu.[/p][/*][/list][h2]Seasonal Shop[/h2][p]The in‑game shop now features a time‑limited seasonal tab with exclusive summer items. Six new designs, each in multiple color variants, are available until August 13 and will return annually starting in 2026.[/p][h2]Revised Daily Quests[/h2][p]Daily quests now refresh at 6 AM instead of midnight. This change ensures evening and late‑night players have ample time to complete their daily challenges.[/p][hr][/hr][p]Thank you for all your valuable feedback in our Discord! This update was shaped entirely by your suggestions. We look forward to your thoughts and wish you happy fishing![/p][p][/p][p]Love,[/p][p]Ostend Games[/p]

tags.feature: In the settings, you can now choose at which rarity level or special catch type your frog will stop fishing and notify you. This lets you focus on rare or unique catches without missing a bite.
Scale: Adjust the frog’s size to your preference.
Drag & Drop: Simply click and drag the frog to a new position—no need to open the settings menu.

The in‑game shop now features a time‑limited seasonal tab with exclusive summer items. Six new designs, each in multiple color variants, are available until August 13 and will return annually starting in 2026.

tags.balance_change: Daily quests now refresh at 6 AM instead of midnight. This change ensures evening and late‑night players have ample time to complete their daily challenges.

notes.title: We've just released a bug-fix update for Desktop Fishing!
notes.content: [p][b]Improved Twitch connection[/b] [/p][p]We fixed connection errors and introduced clear debug messages next to the connection button in the settings to help pinpoint any issues. In Your Twitch Settings under [i]Connections[/i] if you scroll all the way down you can find [i]other connections[/i], where desktop fishing should be listed if connected successfully. [/p][p][/p][p][b]New hotkeys to reposition the frog[/b] [/p][p]This hopefully helps those whose frog is off screen. While the game is the active window (click on game icon in task bar if you do not see the frog) alternate fast between g and either t (move up), f (move left), h (move right), b (move down) keys. [/p][p][/p][p][b]Automatic backup save files[/b] [/p][p]These files are created hourly and located at \\Users\\ [i]yourusername[/i] \\AppData\\LocalLow\\Ostend Games\\Desktop Fishing\\Backups. If you do not see the AppData folder, please enable "Show Hidden Items" in your View Settings. [/p][p][/p][p][b]Aquarium button[/b] [/p][p]The aquarium button on the map now reliably opens the correct aquarium based on the selected location. Thank you for your continued support in making Desktop Fishing a great experience for everyone. We are truly grateful for this awesome community![/p][p][/p][p]Cheers, [/p][p]Ostend Games[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45438360/2d543a2007b75608e481fb5de64cfbfca1de3469.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Patch 1.0.7
notes.content:
Improved Twitch connection
We fixed connection errors and introduced clear debug messages next to the connection button in the settings to help pinpoint any issues. In Your Twitch Settings under Connections if you scroll all the way down you can find other connections, where desktop fishing should be listed if connected successfully. 

New hotkeys to reposition the frog
This hopefully helps those whose frog is off screen. While the game is the active window (click on game icon in task bar if you do not see the frog) alternate fast between g and either t (move up), f (move left), h (move right), b (move down) keys.

Automatic backup save files
These files are created hourly and located at \Users\ yourusername \AppData\LocalLow\Ostend Games\Desktop Fishing\Backups. If you do not see the AppData folder, please enable "Show Hidden Items" in your View Settings.

Aquarium button 
The aquarium button on the map now reliably opens the correct aquarium based on the selected location.

Thank you for your continued support in making Desktop Fishing a great experience for everyone. We are truly grateful for this awesome community! 💚 🐸

tags.bug: The aquarium button on the map now reliably opens the correct aquarium based on the selected location.

notes.title: Big Demo Update and Release Date Reveal
notes.content:
We’re excited to finally reveal the release date of Desktop Fishing. Alongside this, we’re launching our biggest demo update yet, giving players a full preview of what’s to come in the final version.

What is Desktop Fishing?
Desktop Fishing is a cozy idle-fishing game that lives on your screen. While you browse, work, or relax, your frog companion fishes in real-time—no pressure, no FOMO. Reel in fish instantly whenever you like, or just let the game do its thing.
It’s a relaxing companion game with customization, progression, and a surprising amount of charm.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45438360/44ad87069cc92aa7c666f96d2d79b3edd3920252.gif[/img]

What’s new in the demo update?
The latest update brings a full visual and UX overhaul—plus plenty of new content:
New forest biome with unique fish and catchable frog accessories
Expanded frog customization (eye colors, pupil shapes, patterns, hats and more)
Fully redesigned UI and improved frog animations
Shiny and holo fish now feature distinct visual effects
Aquarium preview: showcase your favorite fish
Twitch chat integration: viewers can trigger !catch to reel in fish during streams

“We wanted to make a game that captures the exciting and calming aspects of fishing, without falling into min-maxing—leaving enough room for everything else you do on your PC.”  — Hagen Frick, Ostend Games



Whether you're discovering new fish, dressing up your frog, or just letting things run in the background, Desktop Fishing now feels more alive and cozy than ever.
When is it coming?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45438360/5e8d4fb0a38dbdb720f11ec0cdd4a3eba10dff8b.gif[/img]

Desktop Fishing launches on June 17.  Wishlist the game now to get notified on launch and follow development as we approach release.
